summary: Twelve comment-endorsed electronics, writing, science, food, music, and game-AI resources from 30 fully crawled HN threads.
telegram_footer: 12 items surfaced | 30/30 current front-page stories processed | history + run artifact updated.

items.name: iCEBreaker FPGA board
items.source_story_title: How OpenAI Used Its Own LLMs to Design Its Jalapeño Chip
items.summary: An open-source iCE40 FPGA development board for experimenting with digital circuits.
items.why_included: A hands-on user praised a pair of boards as great experimentation hardware.
items.evidence: The commenter owns two iCEBreaker boards and enjoys using them for circuit experiments.

evidence_sources.author: gregsadetsky
evidence_sources.excerpt: I got a pair of icebreaker boards [0] and they’ve been great to toy around with.

items.name: Saleae Logic
items.source_story_title: How OpenAI Used Its Own LLMs to Design Its Jalapeño Chip
items.summary: A USB logic analyzer and software suite for debugging digital hardware.
items.why_included: A hardware experimenter praised Saleae analyzers in a verifiable AI-design workflow.
items.evidence: The commenter called Saleae analyzers great while describing a circuit-testing loop.

items.name: SDCC
items.summary: A retargetable C compiler for 8051, Z80, Game Boy, and other small devices.
items.why_included: A commercial user reported excellent Z80-family results and bug-free recent Game Boy work.
items.evidence: The commenter found SDCC brilliant on Z80-family targets after mixed 8051 experience.

evidence_sources.author: nickcw
evidence_sources.excerpt: Whereas sdcc works brilliantly for z80 lineage processors.

items.name: WriteLucid
items.source_story_title: I think you should almost never use AI to write
items.summary: An AI writing critic that comments on passages without replacing the author's prose.
items.why_included: Its creator uses it for all writing and values debating passage-level feedback.
items.evidence: The creator reported sustained personal use and strong approval of WriteLucid's critique workflow.

evidence_sources.author: stavros
evidence_sources.excerpt: I really like it, I use it for all my writing nowadays.

items.name: AI Arena
items.summary: A StarCraft II bot ladder for watching and competing with human-written agents.
items.why_included: A commenter directly recommended it for bot matches and ladder participation.
items.evidence: The recommendation invited readers to watch human-written bots or enter the ladder themselves.

evidence_sources.author: tweakimp
evidence_sources.excerpt: If you want to see human written bots in action or compete in the bot ladder yourself, try https://aiarena.net/
